source: Latvian National Archives, University of Latvia student archive, entrants 1919–1944
referencePeriod: 1919–1944 entrants; publisher data last modified 2015-01-20, XML export 2018-09-25
selection: Count the main Uzvards field once per unique archive record, separately by recorded sex. Keep forms observed in at least five records per sex, at most 1,000 per list, descending count then UTF-8 spelling. Omit malformed sex values, empty surnames and strings outside the documented letter/separator filter. Exclude the alternate-surname file. These are historical university-cohort record counts, not modern population frequencies. Only aggregate surname counts are retained.
display: Trim outer whitespace and normalize NFC; otherwise preserve spelling, capitalization and surname forms. No surname suffixes or gender forms are constructed.

sexMappingReview.method: Checked the export against the publisher search results: masculine enrolment label iestājies corresponds to TRUE, feminine iestājusies to FALSE. Confirmed on archive cases 2/11 and 2/36. No gender is inferred from surname suffixes.

nameFilter: At least two characters, starts with a Unicode letter, ends with a Unicode letter or mark; only letters, combining marks, spaces, apostrophes (straight or U+2019) and hyphens. Whitespace-trimmed NFC spellings are aggregated if identical.
licenseScope: The official government catalogue identifies this exact dataset and its publishing government authority and explicitly declares CC0-1.0. Applies to the downloadable CSV/XML dataset; only aggregate name or surname selections are redistributed.
attribution: Latvian National Archives, University of Latvia student archive, entrants 1919–1944. Independently selected and processed by this library.
